```yaml
name: Bump openinference-instrumentation version

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'New version of openinference-instrumentation to bump to'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  bump-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Create branch
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="bump-openinference-instrumentation-${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
          echo "BRANCH_NAME=$BRANCH_NAME" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Bump version in pyproject.toml files
        run: |
          # Find all pyproject.toml files in instrumentor packages
          # Exclude the root pyproject.toml if it exists and is not an instrumentor
          find . -name "pyproject.toml" -not -path "./.git/*" | while read -r file; do
            # Check if the file contains openinference-instrumentation dependency
            if grep -q "openinference-instrumentation" "$file"; then
              # Replace the version constraint for openinference-instrumentation
              # This handles formats like:
              # openinference-instrumentation>=0.1.0
              # openinference-instrumentation >= 0.1.0
              # openinference-instrumentation==0.1.0
              # openinference-instrumentation~=0.1.0
              sed -i -E "s/(openinference-instrumentation[[:space:]]*(>=|>|==|~=|!=|<=|<))[[:space:]]*[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/\1 ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}/g" "$file"
              echo "Updated $file"
            fi
          done

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check-changes
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Changes detected"
            echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"

      - name: Push branch
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        run: |
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ env.BRANCH_NAME }}
          title: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          body: |
            ## Summary
            
            This PR automatically bumps the minimum version of `openinference-instrumentation` to `${{ github.event.inputs.version }}` across all Python instrumentor packages.
            
            ## Changes
            
            - Updated `openinference-instrumentation` dependency version in all relevant `pyproject.toml` files
            
            ## Test plan
            
            - [ ] Verify that all instrumentor packages still install correctly
            - [ ] Run tests to ensure compatibility with the new version
          labels: |
            dependencies
            automated
          draft: false
```
